parse_ebnf_grammar: parse an EBNF grammar file into a ParseState with symbol table and grammar encoding
run_parser_cli: run the EBNF grammar parser CLI to parse and print a grammar file to stdout
break_grammar_into_rules: break a grammar encoding list into individual rule encoding lists by rule boundaries
break_rule_into_elements: break a rule encoding list into its constituent alternate elements
print_grammar: print the parsed grammar rules, hex representation, and decimal representation to a file
